annotations.title: Feed events by company or source

description: List feed items, newest first, from LIVE sources only: SEC filings-wire index metadata (filed and accepted times as SEC lists them) and agency records (publication_date, event_date, fetched_at as stored). Each item carries the stored record unchanged in `record`, its primary document link (primary_url, a government host) and a citation line. Filter by company (CIK or slug), source (an id from list_feed_sources), since/until; page with limit and cursor. A Personal key sees one year of history (history_floor). Companies only, never individuals. Without a key this call costs $0.002 in USDC per call via x402 (send the payment in params._meta["x402/payment"]); a Seraphix Feed key covers it within its quota.

company.description: A tracked company: SEC CIK (leading zeros optional) or slug, e.g. "1692819" or "vistra".

cursor.description: next_cursor from a previous call, to continue the same query.

since.description: ISO 8601 date or date-time. Records compare by publication_date (whole UTC day); filings-wire items by SEC acceptance time.

source.description: A source id from list_feed_sources, e.g. sec-8k or sec-filings-wire.

name: get_feed_events

cite.description: Cite this: the attribution line for this response (CC BY 4.0). Records: cite each by its record_url.
